Listen to 9to5Mac's curated daily headline news summary for you. 9to5Mac Daily is available on iTunes, Apple Podcasts, Stitcher, TuneIn, Google Play, and designated RSS subscription feeds on Overcast, as well as other podcast players.

Sponsored by Stuff: Stuff helps you get everything out of your head and into a simple, elegant system — clearing your mind and reducing mental stress. A simple to-do list for iPhone, iPad, and Mac, paired with powerful tools that make organising, tracking, and completing tasks more satisfying. Get everything done with Stuff.

9to5Mac Daily records a new episode every weekday. Subscribe on Apple Podcasts or your favourite podcast app so you can receive the latest episode as soon as it's available.

News discussed in this episode:

  • watchOS 27.2 beta 2 restores the App Switcher with a new gesture
  • Report says Apple is developing a screenless fitness tracker similar to Whoop
  • What's actually going on with GM's CarPlay strategy (or lack of strategy)
  • Apple retires the unique AR experience at the Apple Park Visitor Center
